entrypoints.summary: The lab directs the user to enter a search value and click Search; the client-side code uses data from location.search.

preconditions: A user loads the deliberately vulnerable search blog page and submits or follows a search value that reaches location.search.

trigger_steps.summary: Enter the documented image payload in the search box and submit the search.

capabilities.concept: HTML markup injection into a search-result DOM element
JavaScript execution through an injected image error handler

impacts.concept: script execution in a user's browser within the vulnerable application context

mitigations.concept: render URL-derived search input as encoded text rather than innerHTML

relation_candidates.dst: HTML markup injection into a search-result DOM element
relation_candidates.rationale: The lab states that location.search data is assigned to innerHTML, which changes the result div's HTML contents.

relation_candidates.dst: JavaScript execution through an injected image error handler
relation_candidates.rationale: The documented injected img has an invalid src that triggers its onerror handler, which calls alert().
relation_candidates.src: HTML markup injection into a search-result DOM element

relation_candidates.dst: script execution in a user's browser within the vulnerable application context
relation_candidates.rationale: The lab identifies alert() execution as the success condition for its DOM XSS attack.
relation_candidates.src: JavaScript execution through an injected image error handler

relation_candidates.dst: render URL-derived search input as encoded text rather than innerHTML
relation_candidates.rationale: The source identifies innerHTML parsing of location.search-derived data as the injection path; preserving text treatment removes that parsing path.
relation_candidates.src: HTML markup injection into a search-result DOM element

impact.affected_asset: A user's browser interaction with the vulnerable search blog page.
impact.attacker_capability: Cause execution of a supplied alert() call through an injected image onerror handler.
impact.security_effect: DOM-based cross-site scripting with JavaScript execution in the rendered page.

causal_trace.summary: Attacker-controlled search data is read from location.search.
The search value is used to change a div's HTML contents through an innerHTML assignment, so the value is treated as HTML rather than inert search text.
An injected img element with an invalid src causes an error, invoking its injected onerror handler.
The injected handler calls alert(), demonstrating JavaScript execution in the page context.

failure.operation: Browser parsing of attacker-injected HTML followed by dispatch of the image error event to an injected onerror handler

primary_invariant.statement: Search input rendered in the result div must remain text and must not be interpreted as attacker-supplied HTML or event-handler-bearing markup.
primary_invariant.violated_because: Data from location.search is assigned through innerHTML, which changes the div's HTML contents.

quality.review_notes: The canonical lab page supplies the source, sink, payload shape, event path, and alert observable, but no live per-run lab URL, execution transcript, application source repository, version scope, patch, or explicit negative control is present. The remediation describes the invariant implied by the documented innerHTML sink and topic-page output-encoding guidance; it is not a reviewed patch.

remediation.invariant_restored: Render search data as text or encode it for the HTML context so location.search-derived input cannot create elements or event handlers in the result div.
mitigation_classes: avoid parsing untrusted search data as HTML

affected_versions_or_commits.value: Observed 2026-07-16; no explicit page or application version marker

target.component: search blog functionality and its result div
target.project_or_package: PortSwigger Web Security Academy DOM XSS lab

oracle.expected_negative: No explicit negative/control condition is published in the supplied lab page.
oracle.expected_positive: After entering in the search box and clicking Search, the invalid src triggers onerror and calls alert().
